t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The orange, green, red and blue gnomes lead to the light forrest and the other one of their pair leads to the dark forest. This is the same no matter what the multiplier is. I need to work out which forest has the most mushrooms

vb_textbox.text: Hi,The gnomes appear in pairs that are the same each time. It doesnt matter which side the gnomes are on but the brown, purple, yellow and pink gnomes always lead to a light forest and the others always lead to a dark forest. The forest which has the most mushrooms appears to switch quite often and it is hard to keep track of which has the most. What I found to be the best technique was to keep with one until it produced few mushrooms then switched to the others.The number of mushrooms found is shown under the total amount which is helpful to keep track how much you found regardless of the multiplier. Good luck!
